summary: Tiny kerb beside a shop at a junction; cars park here, flats 19 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Shop building 3 m away (non-residential); nearest dwellings are flats 19-21 m away, across the road and behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Public kerb with cars parked on it in both images; 9 m is barely a van length, at the junction mouth.
drivers.traffic: Junction with a side street; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, but a 2P Mon-Fri 9am-4pm limit applies and the spot is exposed at the corner.

sun_shade: Open; the shop building to the west shades it in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the shop has residents above

best_section.where: Beatrice Street west kerb, directly beside the old shop building at the cross street
